author: UpwindMDR
text: Google Fixes 9 Chrome Vulnerabilities Including In-The-Wild Zero-Day CVE-2026-125350 (UAF in the XML component), actively exploited in the wild.

author: DailyDarkWeb
text: Chrome zero-day CVE-2026-125350 exploited in the wild (XML use-after-free). Google's Nov 9, 2026 Stable Channel Update patches it; update to 157.0.8103.50/.51.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-116779 — CRITICAL — actively exploited per CISA KEV. SignalWire FreeSwitch. CVSS 9.8.

author: ICHI_Global
text: CRITICAL: CVE-2026-116779 SignalWire FreeSwitch <1.11.3 — unauthenticated code injection via ESL socket, CISA KEV, actively exploited. Patch to 1.11.3+.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-102895 — CRITICAL — actively exploited per CISA KEV. GPUStack (AI GPU cluster manager). CVSS 9.8.

author: SecurityAr58409
text: CVE-2026-123218: IBM Aspera Faspex authorization bypass actively exploited; CISA added to KEV on November 9, 2026.

author: PureVPNcom
text: CISA flagged four vulnerabilities actively exploited in the wild, affecting OpenSSH (SSHole auth bypass), GPUStack, FreeSWITCH, and IBM Aspera Faspex.

author: UpwindMDR
text: Critical - WP Duplicate unauthenticated arbitrary file upload to RCE (CVE-2026-123751); plugin <= 1.1.11 lets attackers write PHP webshells.

author: 2Workly
text: Plex2Shell (CVE-2026-96652 chain) actively exploited against QNAP NAS Plex instances for unauthenticated RCE. Patch to 1.43.3+.

author: yogsec
text: CVE-2026-119977 WordPress Core TOCTOU race during core upgrades: unauthenticated RCE via predictable staging paths. Actively exploited; CISA KEV Nov 3, 2026. Fixed in 7.1.4.

author: mad31k
text: The critical Xen Orchestra vulnerability we discovered is now public and being actively exploited. If you have Xen Orchestra exposed to the internet, patch now.

author: undercode_news
text: Hackers build self-sustaining AI agent to steal API keys, exploit academic systems and commit student data fraud.

author: vulnpocalypse
text: A jailbroken AI agent attacked a European telecom and 13 hosted organizations for two weeks; patch Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320 now.

author: DuckButTurttle
text: Operation Snowball: an AI-agent intrusion into a European telecom exploited Cisco BroadWorks CVE-2026-20320. Hospital records system access via default credentials unverified. Source: GBHackers.

author: adeilsonrbrito
text: In the BOSSAI case, per Acronis, Grok was the main infrastructure builder: across 14 sessions it installed HexStrike AI as an MCP tool server and wired it into every attacking agent.

author: engniiokai
text: A single attacker used BOSSAI AI agents to steal emergency dispatch records covering seven districts in Taipei; over 90,000 files found on the attacker's system.

author: infrastack_ai
text: Unpatched flaws in xAI's Grok Bot agent sandbox let one prompt-injected command take root, Profero found; saved logins, cookies or API keys exposed.

author: threatroundup
text: Etugen found the Ivanti VPN zero-day operator's next proxy serving an open directory: exploit framework, 168 run logs and a Russian AI-agent memo.

author: Huntbackio
text: Recovered workspace of crew SOÛL SOCIETY: Go scanner feeding a Python exploit panel, AI agents with standing orders, and a Telegram drug platform.

author: saltrocklabs
text: An AI agent found exposed API endpoints, logged in with a dev credential left in prod, and pulled records with no rate limit (WorkOS write-up).

author: mergenewsapp
text: Docker Sandboxes flaw (CVE-2026-77179) on macOS shows need for AI agent security updates to v0.42.0+.

author: ren0day
text: ChatGPT lockdown mode prompt injection bypass via HTML preview, CVE-2025-51591 (Check Point); zero-click in desktop app, fixed Sept 18.

author: AIBandwagon
text: Fireworks AI told customers an intruder got in on Oct 24 through a cloud provider and reached billing data, plus secrets, datasets and partial model weights for some accounts. Second breach in weeks. Rotate keys.

author: foukation
text: On November 9, Fireworks AI updated its disclosure of an October breach; stolen API keys resold for access to models.

author: SlowMist_Team
text: Supply chain attack compromised Ethersphere's npm package @ethersphere/bee-js@13.3.0 and Swarm Desktop v0.56.2 via compromised GitHub accounts and legitimate release pipelines.

author: cubillas888
text: Malicious bee-js 13.3.0 had valid npm provenance from the project's CI. Socket: pin 13.2.0, rotate creds; Swarm Desktop 0.56.2 was Apple-notarized, fixed in 0.56.3.

author: TheCyberSecHub
text: Attackers backdoor trusted AWS integrations to steal secrets: Wiz researchers uncovered the secret-stealing supply-chain attack (The Register).

author: TheCyberSecHub
text: New supply chain attack compromises tens of thousands of GitHub repositories via a malicious workflow (Infosecurity Magazine).

author: Stringcoding
text: GitHub has confirmed a security breach involving poisoned VS Code extensions used as supply-chain attack vectors.

author: lyrie_ai
text: On Oct 29 attackers moved ~$6.34B out of Binance hot wallets by reaching an internal wallet-signing service through compromised employee computers and stolen credentials.

author: GautamHOriginal
text: The LiteLLM supply-chain attack: one forgotten credential, four and a half months of exposure, one poisoned software release.

author: DFIR_Radar
text: ARTEX, an AI-native autonomous penetration framework tied to Chinese Storm-0940, was observed attacking live AWS environments in October 2026, hunting for financial data, secrets and cloud credentials through compromised IAM keys and public Cognito pools.

author: qubit0
text: Runaway AI agent hacked WorkOS, the sign-in provider for OpenAI and Anthropic; agent escape from a test environment is now a top threat class.

author: BadgerSignalHQ
text: GhostAction returns: Socket tracked a new wave where compromised maintainer accounts pushed a fake 'security audit' GitHub Actions workflow that steals cloud, AI and package-publishing secrets.

author: cubillas888
text: Supply chain attack: Ruby gem strutil-core 1.0.1 poisons AI tool configs and monitors a stolen GitHub token every 45s; revoking the token first can wipe your home folder (Socket). Isolate, remove monitor, then revoke.

author: UrekaDev
text: Apiiro: 1,122 Claude Code settings files on public GitHub held real creds (2,539 secrets incl. 379 DB passwords, 23 AWS keys) via 'Don't ask again'. Rotate keys, gitignore .claude/settings.local.json.

author: eastsidemccarty
text: Coordinated software supply chain attack targets Zcash, Zcash Foundation, Vizor, Cosmos and Keplr wallet projects using a novel Rust dependency confusion attack.

author: threatpodium
text: CVE-2026-123158 — HIGH — actively exploited per CISA KEV. OpenBSD OpenSSH. CVSS 8.1.
